about_the_game:
Chornobyl Breakout is a first-person shooter where you become a survivor pilot whose helicopter has crashed in the Chornobyl Exclusion Zone. You must find a way to safe place. From the first steps, you are enveloped by the ominous silence of abandoned locations. Ruined buildings, rusted cars, and overgrown vegetation serve as reminders of the catastrophe that occurred here. The atmosphere of tension permeates every corner, and every shadow may conceal a threat. Your survival skills will be put to the test as you navigate through dangerous areas. Will you choose a direct path, risking encounters with hostile creatures, or will you prefer a more cautious approach, exploring the ruins in search of supplies and weapons? As you progress, you will face a variety of challenges that will keep you on your toes. From humans to mutated wildlife, danger lurks everywhere. Will you overcome all obstacles and escape from Chornobyl, or will you become just another lost soul in this dead world?

Key Features:

  • Immersive Gameplay. Experience the game from a first-person perspective, enhancing the sense of realism and immersion.  

  • Realistic Environment. Explore a richly detailed world filled with ruined buildings, rusted vehicles, and overgrown vegetation.  

  • Challenging Quests. Complete various missions and challenges.  

  • Cooperative Mode. Embrace the campaign with up to 4 players via Steam or LAN.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+ / Fedora 35+ (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-Core Intel or AMD
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1GB VRAM GDDR5, OpenGL 3.2 or Vulkan capable
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD highly recommended

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS Big Sur 11.0 or above
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 or AMD Radeon R9
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
